entities.rationale: User icon on the left labeled USER, with handwritten '300k' note beneath; starting point of the request flow. Not inside any container.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Bucket icon labeled S3 at the top, above CloudFront; arrow drawn down to CloudFront (origin for static content). Not inside any container.

entities.name: CloudFront
entities.rationale: Icon labeled CLOUDFRONT in the middle row; receives arrows from User, S3 and Lambda, and sends an arrow to the Load Balancer. Not inside any container.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Icon labeled LAMBDA in the bottom row, below CloudFront, with an arrow pointing up to CloudFront. Not inside any container.

entities.name: Load Balancer
entities.rationale: Icon labeled LOAD BALANCER in the middle row between CloudFront and EKS; handwritten '60' next to it. Not inside any container.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Icon labeled EKS in the middle row; handwritten '80 / 250' above it. Receives traffic from the Load Balancer and has arrows to RDS and Mongo/Kafka. Not inside any container.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.rationale: Icon with stacked squares labeled LEGACY in the top row; legacy system receiving an arrow from the Load Balancer. Not inside any container.

entities.name: Mongo/Kafka
entities.rationale: Database icon labeled MONGO/KAFKA at the top right; a single generic icon representing Mongo and Kafka data stores, receiving an arrow from EKS. Not inside any container.

entities.name: RDS
entities.rationale: Icon labeled RDS at the right of the middle row; receives an arrow from EKS. Not inside any container.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: Icon labeled EC2 in the bottom row; a curved line without a visible arrowhead runs from its left side up toward the CloudFront / Load Balancer area. Not inside any container.

entities.name: CloudWatch
entities.rationale: Icon labeled CLOUDWATCH in the bottom row at the right; a curved line leaves its right side going upward to the right with no clear target visible. Not inside any container.
